uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When damaged, paralyzes nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD). The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this Ability is decreased by 30% for 2.5s and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Paralyzes all enemies nearby for a short time when receiving damage. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the opposing Pokémon hit. The movement speed of the opposing Pokémon paralyzed by boosted attacks is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 1s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also paralyzes enemies for a short time when it hits.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also paralyzes enemies for a short time when it hits.

Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and paralyzing them when it hits. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 30% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Slows enemies briefly. Release electricity, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also paralyzes enemies for a short time.

Hurls an electric orb at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, dealing additional missing HP damage, and paralyzing them when it hits. The movement speed of opposing Pokémon paralyzed by this move is decreased by 50% and their basic attack speed is decreased by 10% for 2s. Against wild Pokémon: additional missing HP damage is capped at 1200. 6% of enemy missing HP. Hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them paralyzed for a short time. This move's damage increases the lower the enemies remaining HP is.
Increases the damage of this move. 8% of enemy missing HP. Increased damage.

Drops wicked thunderbolts at the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.5s over 2.5s (up to 5 times). Drop wicked thunderbolts, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
Deals damage over time more frequently, hitting opposing Pokémon in the area of effect up to 7 times over 2.5s. Increases the number of times this move attacks.

Launches an electric net at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target and immobilizing them for 1.5s when the net captures them. Attacks and captures enemies using an electric net, leaving them unable to move.

Becomes unstoppable and dashes at the designated opposing Pokémon, damaging the target 5 times and throwing them in the air for 1.4s; then leaps a set distance back, becoming vulnerable to hindrances and increasing movement speed by 60% for 2s (decaying by 10% every 0.5s; minimum 30% for 0.5s) after the leap. Has the user electrify itself and charge ahead, throwing opposing Pokémon.
Reduces this move's cooldown by 2s. Reduced cooldown.

Strikes with a strong electric blast at the designated area, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and stunning them for 1.25s when it hits. Attack with a strong electric blast, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

Becomes unstoppable and jumps into the air, then casts down bolts of lightning 4 times over 3s in a radius around Pikachu. The first cast targets all Pokémon on the opposing team in range with 1 bolt each; these bolts damage up to 1 target each. The following 3 casts target up to 2 random Pokémon from the opposing team in range; these following bolts deal damage to opposing Pokémon in a small area around them, but targets can only be damaged once for each of the following 3 casts. Pikachu can act freely once the first bolts of lightning are cast down. Attacks enemies near the user with tremendous bolts of lightning.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
